name: Pteranodon
pageNumbering: Printed folio and one-based page number agree.
habitatSource: Coasts, sea cliffs and tropical islands are editorial encounter terms informed by the flying animal. The Basic Rules description has no habitat line.
appearanceSource: Basic Rules p. 150 describes a flying reptile with a sharp toothless beak. Crest and colors are editorial features of the selected reused portrait.
sourceDistinctions: The two printings agree on the mechanics. Flyby applies when the pteranodon flies out of an enemy’s reach.

name: Pteranodon

appearanceSource: Monster Manual p. 79 describes a 15-to-20-ft. wingspan and toothless beak. The backward crest, coloration and poses are editorial features of the selected reused portrait.
sourceDistinctions: The two printings agree on the mechanics. Flyby applies when the pteranodon flies out of an enemy’s reach.
